description:
Secure crypto wallet for 100+ blockchains: Bitcoin, USDT, ETH, Solana, and more.

Gem Wallet is an open-source, non-custodial crypto wallet for 100+ blockchains. No registration or personal data is required: back up your recovery phrase and stay in control of your funds.

Wallet
  • Send and receive Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, USDT, USDC, BNB, XRP, TRON, TON, and many other assets.
  • Manage USDT on TRON (TRC20), Ethereum (ERC20), Solana, TON, and more.
  • Manage multiple wallets and accounts in one app.
  • Add custom tokens and custom RPC nodes.
  • View and send NFTs on popular blockchains.
  • Find any asset quickly with search, and follow trending tokens and market data.
Swap, Earn, and Trade
  • Swap tokens on the same chain or across chains through integrated providers such as Uniswap, PancakeSwap, Jupiter, Orca, THORChain, Chainflip, Mayan, Relay, and STON.fi.
  • Stake supported assets and track your rewards.
  • Earn with yield-bearing stablecoins.
  • Trade Hyperliquid perpetuals.
  • Buy and sell crypto through third-party providers.
Payments
  • Pay with QR codes or from saved contacts.
  • Only the blockchain network fee is charged on transfers.
  • Review transaction details before signing.
Security and Privacy
  • Private keys are encrypted and never leave your device.
  • Protect access with a PIN and biometric authentication.
  • Warnings for suspicious tokens and transactions.
  • No registration or personal account is required.
  • Open-source code is available for review.
F-Droid Build

This build has no Google Play Services, push notifications, or WalletConnect.

Project Information

Website: https://gemwallet.com
